title: Protocols to generate and isolate mouse myogenic progenitors both in vitro and in vivo
protocol: Differentiate mESCs using bone morphogenetic protein 4 (BMP4) and remove LIF and 2i (CHIR99021 and PD0325901).
Change the culture medium of instructed mESCs to aPSM differentiation medium.
Expose instructed mESCs to chemicals LDN193189 and Rspo3 in aPSM medium for differentiation towards Pax3 expression.
FACS sort approximately 30-40% Pax3-GFP positive cells based on GFP expression.
Switch the medium to HIFLR supplemented with hepatocyte growth factor (HGF), insulin growth factor 1 (IGF-1), fibroblast growth factor 2 (FGF-2), LDN193189, and Rspo3 for additional 48 hours.
FACS sort Pax3-GFP positive cells again after the additional treatment period.
Thaw mESCs.
Plate mESCs on gelatin-coated 6-well plates.
Maintain mESCs in maintenance medium.
Passage the cells twice before starting differentiation.
Remove culture medium from mESCs on day 0.
Wash mESCs once with 1 mL PBS.
Add 200–300 μL trypsin for 3–5 min at 37°C to detach the cells.
Collect mESCs into a 15 mL falcon tube with 3 mL instructing medium after detaching.
Centrifuge cells at 160–185 × g for 5 min at 25°C.
Resuspend the cells in 1 mL instructing medium and count them.
Determine cell number using Cellometer Vision according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Plate 140–150K cells per well of gelatin-coated 6-well plates (total volume for each well is 2 mL of instructing medium).
Culture the cells for two days.
Carefully remove the instructing medium on day 2.
Wash the cells with 1 mL of 1× PBS carefully, avoiding shaking the plate.
Remove PBS and add 2 mL aPSM differentiation medium to each well.
Continue culturing the cells for four days in aPSM medium.
Remove aPSM medium on day 6.
Add 2 mL HIFLR medium to each well.
Keep HIFLR medium for additional two days.
Prepare GFP-positive cells for FACS sorting on day 8.
Add 300–500 μL of trypsin to each well for 5–10 min at 37°C.
Gently pipette cells every 1–2 min until cells detach.
Transfer the cells to a 15 mL falcon tube and add 5 mL medium to the falcon tube.
Spin at 160 × g for 3 min and discard supernatant carefully.
Resuspend the pellet with an appropriate amount (500 μL–2000 μL) of differentiation medium.
Add 1 mM EDTA to differentiation medium.
Transfer the cells through a 40 μm cell strainer sitting on a 15 mL falcon tube or through polystyrene round-bottom tube with cell-strainer cap.
Fill a bucket with ice.
Fill 4 petri dishes and one 12-well culture plate with 1× PBS and place them on ice.
Sanitize dissection tools (2 scissors, 2 forceps) with 70% ethanol spray and Kimwipes.
Euthanize a pregnant mouse at day 12 after a positive plug by CO2 asphyxia according to ACUC regulations.
Position the mouse belly up on a clean paper towel.
Spray the belly with 70% ethanol.
Make a 1 cm cut on the belly skin with scissors.
Pull the skin bidirectionally toward the head and the toe to expose the sac containing a string of embryos.
Make a cut on the body wall of the abdominal cavity.
Carefully remove the whole string of embryos and transfer them into a petri dish placed on ice.
Peel off each uterus wall to release each embryo into the dish.
Tear the amniotes and vascularized yolk sac membranes to expose the embryo.
Cut off the umbilical cord from placenta.
Rinse all embryos in a new petri dish with 1× PBS.
Allocate each embryo in one well of a 12-well culture plate.
Screen embryos under the fluorescent dissecting microscope to identify Pax7+/Cre; Rosa26YFP/+ embryos.
Mark the wells with YFP-positive embryos.
Eviscerate the embryo’s abdominal and thoracic cavities.
Flatten the embryo in the dish with belly down and back up.
Cut the posterior half of the embryo through the trunk region between the two pairs of limbs.
Carve out the YFP-positive spinal cord using fine-tipped forceps and discard it.
Place the remaining tissue, including YFP-positive somites, in a 1.5 mL tube with 250 μL cold 1× PBS on ice.
Repeat dissection steps to finish all YFP-positive embryos, each in one 1.5 mL tube.
Mince the tissue in each tube using scissors.
Add 250 μL embryo dissociation medium to each tube.
Incubate the tubes in a 33°C water bath for 20 min.
Pipette up and down with a 1 ml tip while incubating to assist with dissociation.
Add 500 μL somite sorting medium to stop the digestion of tissue.
Move dissociated tissue into a 15 mL falcon tube and resuspend with 10 mL somite sorting medium.
Filter each resuspended tissue through a 40 μm cell strainer sitting on a 50 mL falcon tube.
Centrifuge 50 mL Falcon tubes at approximately 210 × g to spin down cells.
Carefully remove the supernatant from each tube by aspirating through a 2 mL pipette.
Coat the strainer top with 100 μL FBS before filtering.
Resuspend the pellet with 500 μL somite sorting medium and filter through a 5 mL Falcon tube with a strainer top (40 μm).
FACS-isolate cells by gating on GFP channel.
Store collected YFP-positive cells in −80°C freezer or use immediately for RNA extraction.
